title: Jackknife-conformal uncertainty for linear ACE potentials: code, results and paper source
description: Analysis code, results, figures and paper source for J. R. Kermode, Jackknife-conformal uncertainty for linear ACE potentials: calibrated forces and silicon properties compared with Bayesian and POPS baselines, arXiv:2611.08678 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08678). The uncertainty methods are part of ace-jax 0.5.3 (https://github.com/ACEsuit/ace-jax); this archive holds the study that uses them: every number and figure in the paper is generated from results/ by bench/si_qoi_uq/artifact/paper.py.

creators.name: Kermode, James R.
